title: Libraries Near Me Map: Find a Public Library
description: Map the public libraries near any place with the Libraries Near Me Map — from open map records, nearest first. Free.
summary_sentence: Results are limited to returned OpenStreetMap records and may omit closer or unmapped places. Confirm details with an authoritative local source.
quick_answer: The tool searches OpenStreetMap for mapped library records around a chosen location, then sorts returned records by straight-line distance. It requests at most 200 records and displays up to 100, so it cannot guarantee the closest result or a complete list. Data, access and opening status can be incomplete or outdated.

faq: Does it show opening hours?
No. The tool shows names, points and distances, not hours or services. Check the library directly.
How complete is the list?
Coverage varies. Results are capped, so even mapped libraries may be omitted; verify important searches with the local library system.
Can I use the tool without sharing my precise location?
You can search for a place instead of using device location. The selected search centre is sent to OpenStreetMap-based services for the lookup.
Why might a boundary or place name look different elsewhere?
Library names come from the map record; systems rebrand branches occasionally and other sources may lag or lead.
Does MapBench store my browser location?
Device location is optional. The selected coordinates are sent to Overpass to search; consult the privacy page for provider and site details.
University libraries included?
Where recorded and tagged as libraries they can appear; access rules for academic libraries differ — the institution's site decides who walks in.
Can I join from here?
Membership is the system's process (usually ID and an address check in person or online). This page's job ends at the door — happily.
Bookmobile stops?
Rarely recorded as fixed libraries; systems publish their mobile schedules on their own sites.
A library closed years ago still shows.
Map data ages where nobody edits. OpenStreetMap accepts corrections from anyone — the fix helps the next searcher.
Can I see real-time book availability?
No — catalogues belong to the library system's own site, which the branch result helps you identify. This map's layer is geography.
Mobile library stops?
Rarely in the fixed record; systems publish mobile schedules themselves. The static branches here are the reliable skeleton.
